title: Cellar Vowel Wreck
description: A grimy, hollow vocal-formant sawtooth lead that mouths stepped vowels like a garage stab gone to seed. Over 32 cycles its bit depth collapses from clean to crushed while the formant vowel slides and a resonant bandpass tightens, then a room+delay tail smears the wreckage into the back wall.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 [c4 d4] f4 eb4>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .vowel("<a e o i a e u o>/2")
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 5))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 1 3 2>/8")
    .shape(saw.slow(23).range(0.12, 0.42))
    .bpf(saw.slow(13).range(1400, 520)).resonance("<8 11 14 10>/16").ftype("ladder")
    .bpenv("<3 5 7 4>/8").bpattack(0.01).bpdecay(0.12)
    .ply("<1 1 2 1 2>/8")
    .mask("1 1 0 1 1 0 1 1".euclidLegato("<5 7 6>/16", 8))
    .tremolosync("<2 4 8>/8").tremolodepth("<0.4 0.6 0.8>/16")
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.11)).gain(0.35))
    .room(saw.slow(29).range(0.15, 0.6)).roomsize(4)
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.55").orbit(2)
    .gain(0.85)
)
